# Philips Norelco HS85 Shaving Unit: Replacement Heads for a Smoother Shave

## Shave Comfortably With a Flexible Design
The flex tracker follows the curves of your face as you shave, helping protect your skin from irritation. Glide rings on the shaving heads let the unit move smoothly across your face, so each pass feels easy and controlled.

## Restore Your HS8000 Series Shaver
Worn-out heads can dull even a reliable electric shaver. This replacement shaving unit refreshes your Philips Norelco HS8000 series razor, giving you a close, comfortable shave without replacing the entire device. Compatible heads are listed by model number, so confirm yours before you order.

## Keep Your Routine Simple
Swapping in new heads is a practical alternative to buying a new electric razor each time the blades wear down. For a moisturizing shave, pair your unit with compatible shaving lotion or gel, and use the HQ 200 cleaning solution with your JetClean System to keep it fresh.

## Upgrade Your Shave Today
Find your Philips Norelco model number, choose the matching shaving unit, and order today to enjoy a smoother, more comfortable shave.

---

I wrote this as a replacement shaving unit for HS8000 series shavers, since the listing and reviews both point that way. The price was missing, so I left it out. I also left out the average rating and the review complaints, per your guidelines.
